questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

__**The avalanche of new data have been as overwhelming**__ that many scientists who were skeptical about Bronze Age migrations into India have changed their opinions.

options.text: The avalanche of new data has been as overwhelming
The avalanche of new data has been so overwhelming
The avalanche of new data have been so overwhelming

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The avalanche of new data has been so overwhelming.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, 'avalanche' is the subject which is **singular**. Hence, the **verb** that must agree with it must also be **singular (has)**. Hence, options 3) and 4) are incorrect as the plural verb 'have' is used.
 
• **'So' **and **'that'** are** correlative conjunctions** i.e., they are used in pair.
 
 
• *Example: The words tumbled out **so**__ fast __**that**__ I could barely hear them.*
 
 
 
• *​*Similarly, in this context, the use of 'that' in the latter part of the sentence hints at the fact that the underlined part must have 'so'. This makes option 1) incorrect.
 
• So, clearly **option 2 **is correct.

__**Correct Sentence:**__ *__**The avalanche of new data has been so overwhelming**__ that many scientists who were skeptical about Bronze Age migrations into India have changed their opinions.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'As'** is **used in comparisons to refer to the extent or degree of something.**

 
 
• *Example: "go **as** fast** as **you can"*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.

Genetic influx from Central Asia in the Bronze Age was strongly male-driven, consistent with the patriarchal social structure __**attributing to the Indo-European**__ pastoralist society.

options.text: to be attributed to the Indo-European

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 3.**

Clearly the given sentence is in past tense which can be observed from the word 'was'. So, we will use the past tense form of the verb i.e. attributed. Also, 'by' means using something by the means of other. 'To' shows the destination or the point of conclusion. Here, we will use 'to' to show that genetic influx from Central Asia in the Bronze Age was strongly male-driven, consistent with the patriarchal social structure which led** to the**__ Indo-European__ pastoralist society. So, option 3 is correct,
